focus: Review for the former Sears Canada directors to reconcile defence costs actually paid or awaiting payment and the remaining available insurance funding through July 2019. Identify documents reporting actual payments, invoices, remaining balances, or allocation of actual defence payments between policies. Exclude a notice, conditional coverage demand, policy limit or request for information standing alone when it does not report actual payments, invoices or remaining available funding. General coverage arguments and store or dividend operations alone are outside this focused accounting review.

Review for Air Passenger Rights. Identify evidence of how the Canadian Transportation Agency developed, approved, communicated or defended its March 2020 statement about vouchers instead of refunds, including independence from airlines and government. General advocacy history or unrelated passenger disputes alone are outside scope.

Review for the airport creditors in the Lynx Air CCAA proceeding. Identify evidence of airport improvement fees collected, owed, remitted or held by Lynx, contractual rights to those fees, and treatment of those claims in the insolvency. General corporate history, aircraft leases or other creditors' debts alone are outside scope.

Review for the Canadian Civil Liberties Association in the federal prison COVID-19 proceeding. Identify evidence of requests to reduce the prison population, available release mechanisms, infection risks, and the federal response to those requests. General biographical material or unrelated prison grievances alone are outside scope.

Review for the proposed interested party NCCC. Identify evidence of the Commission's mandate, representation, consultation with First Nations, and positions on reform of First Nations child and family services or Jordan's Principle, relevant to its request for participation. Historical material with no bearing on those issues is outside scope.

Review for Safe Food Matters and Prevent Cancer Now. Identify evidence concerning the PMRA's chlorpyrifos cancellation and three-year phase-out, the reasons or evidentiary basis for those decisions, and access to the regulatory record. Other pesticides and general environmental advocacy alone are outside scope.

Review for the encampment residents in the Waterloo proceeding. Identify evidence concerning the encampment, residents' needs, genuinely accessible shelter or housing alternatives, and the municipality's proposed removal and accommodation measures. General homelessness commentary without a connection to those issues is outside scope.

Review for the Ontario Health Coalition and Advocacy Centre for the Elderly. Identify evidence concerning consent to hospital discharge or long-term care admission, placement decisions under Bill 7, distance from family, and charges or pressure imposed on patients refusing placement. Unrelated health policy alone is outside scope.

Review for the former players in the Canadian Hockey League hazing proceeding. Identify evidence concerning player abuse or hazing, league or team knowledge, reporting and discipline, prevention policies, and common systems of supervision. General hockey administration, game results or player publicity without a connection to those issues is outside scope.

Review for Canacol in its CCAA proceeding. Identify evidence concerning termination or continuation of Colombian gas supply contracts, supply shortages, regulatory or ministerial intervention, and the effect on restructuring. General industry news, corporate history or unrelated financing alone is outside scope.
